title: Spatial scene
description: A night photo of Times Square, with herb standing in the street, that turns out to have depth. Move across it and the city shifts behind him: herb, the pedicab and the taxis slide over street and storefronts that were hidden behind them a moment ago. The photo was split offline into four layers at its depth edges, each one inpainted behind the layers in front, and each drawn as a mesh displaced by its own depth, so the reveal is real street rather than a smear.
intent: Apple's Spatial Scenes (iOS 26 lock screen and Photos, https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/spatial-scenes) and Facebook 3D Photos (2018, https://ai.meta.com/blog/powered-by-ai-turning-any-2d-photo-into-3d-using-convolutional-neural-nets/): a flat photo you know suddenly has depth that behaves correctly, foreground sliding over background that was hidden behind it.
